interface.title: KBarn Social Network Explorer
interface.field: Behavioural ecology / animal social network analysis (mouse colonies tracked by RFID)
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis and exploration of tracking data after collection, with export of results for downstream statistics
interface.what_it_is_for: Turn RFID co-location reads from a mouse colony into association networks, permutation-tested dyads, group cohesion over time, and per-mouse social phenotypes and types, all set from one sidebar of parameters.

data.note: I uploaded Pen1-lower.csv and Pen1-upper.csv and pressed Load data, which gave '201 reads · 4 mice' (M101–M104). M105 was not listed anywhere, as expected from the min-reads filter. Loading from the pre-filled folder /work/KBarn_RFID/data failed with 'No usable Pen*.csv files' (screens/005.webp). The data cover 01-01 08:00 to 12:05, so even the shortest temporal window (6h) gives only two windows (06h and 12h).

tree.general: Describe the social structure of an animal group from proximity-logger data, from group to individual
tree.specific: Build SRI association networks from KBarn RFID co-location CSVs, test dyads by datastream permutation, track group sociality over time, and profile each mouse's 14-parameter sociality phenotype

features.name: Data loader with upload-or-folder fallback
features.general: Bring in several raw log files by upload, or point at a server folder, then load and see a summary of what was kept
features.specific: Upload RFID CSVs (several at once) or type a data folder, press 📂 Load data, read the 'N reads · M mice' badge or the 'Load failed' error
steps: Drop one or more CSVs into the uploader (or type a folder path)
Press Load data
Read the success badge (reads/animals kept) or the error message
Remove a file with ⊗ or add more with + and reload
serves_tasks: Load the raw tracking files

features.name: Global analysis-parameter sidebar that recomputes every view
features.general: One panel of time resolution, threshold, resampling count, cluster count and time-range controls that every chart and table reads from, with the active settings echoed in a header line
features.specific: Sampling period, Edge threshold (min SRI), Temporal window, Permutations, Phenotype clusters (k, only in the Individual layer) and Date range slider; the caption under the title shows period/window/threshold/date span
steps: Pick sampling period and temporal window from dropdowns
Drag the edge-threshold and permutation sliders
Drag the date-range handles to restrict the span
Check that the header caption and the views update
serves_tasks: Choose time resolution and analysis settings
Restrict the analysis to a time span
Test whether each pairwise bond is stronger or weaker than chance

features.name: Association network with community colouring and node-metrics table
features.general: Draw a weighted network of individuals (edge width = association strength, node size = centrality, colour = detected community) next to its matrix heatmap and a per-node centrality table
features.specific: Association network plot (colour = community, size = strength, modularity in the title), SRI matrix heatmap and Node network metrics table (strength, partners, eigenvector, betweenness, clustering)
steps: Open the Association network tab
Read communities and modularity from the plot
Compare pairwise SRI in the heatmap
Rank individuals by centrality in the metrics table
Open any figure full size in a new tab
serves_tasks: Build and view the association network and matrix
Find hubs, brokers and isolates

features.name: Permutation-tested dyad graph with pair picker
features.general: Classify every pair as preferred, avoided or neutral against a randomisation null, show the significant pairs as a coloured graph and table, and plot any chosen pair's association across time windows
features.specific: Significant dyads (datastream permutation, p≤0.05): green = preferred, red = avoided; table of sri/together/p_preferred/p_avoided/class; Mouse A / Mouse B dropdowns drive 'association over time (class)'
steps: Set the permutation count in the sidebar
Open Significant dyads and read the graph and table
Pick Mouse A and Mouse B
Read that pair's SRI-over-time plot, titled with its class
serves_tasks: Test whether each pairwise bond is stronger or weaker than chance
Follow one pair's association across time

features.name: Fixed-layout network snapshots over time
features.general: Small-multiple network drawings, one per time window, in a fixed node layout so fragmentation into subgroups can be seen; each panel has its modularity
features.specific: Communities & snapshots tab: community membership table plus 'Network snapshots over time (edge SRI > threshold)' with m= per window (snapshot nodes are unlabelled)
steps: Choose the temporal window and threshold in the sidebar
Open Communities & snapshots
Compare the panels window by window
serves_tasks: Find subgroups and watch them change

features.name: Group-level metrics over time with two independent centrality pickers
features.general: Headline group statistics, a histogram of pairwise association, a per-window 2×2 panel of group metrics, and two separate dropdowns: one chooses which per-individual centrality is ranked across individuals, the other which centrality is tracked per individual over time
features.specific: Group Sociality → Group sociality metrics: Mean SRI / Density / Differentiation / Modularity cards, SRI distribution histogram, and a 'Centrality metric' dropdown (strength/eigenvector/partners/betweenness/clustering) driving the 'across mice' bars. Temporal dynamics: per-window cohesion/density/differentiation/modularity panel and its own 'Centrality metric' dropdown (independent of the first; defaults to strength) driving the 'over time (per mouse)' heatmap + trajectory
steps: Read the four headline metrics and the dyad-SRI histogram
Pick a centrality on the metrics tab to re-rank individuals
Open Temporal dynamics to see group metrics per window
Pick a centrality on that tab's own dropdown for the per-mouse heatmap and trajectory
Download Group-over-time CSV
serves_tasks: Get whole-group summary statistics
Track group structure and individual centrality across time windows
Find hubs, brokers and isolates

features.name: Directed approach matrix
features.general: Count how often each individual joins another's location and show it as an asymmetric heatmap (row → column), exportable as a table
features.specific: Approach tab: 'Approach counts — row a joins column b's location' heatmap with counts; Approach matrix CSV
steps: Open the Approach tab
Read the approacher rows against the approached columns
Download Approach matrix CSV
serves_tasks: See who follows whom (directed approaches)

features.name: Multi-parameter phenotype profiling with PCA and k-clustering
features.general: Z-score a panel of per-individual measures, show them as a heatmap, project them with PCA, cluster into k labelled types, and explain each type by its mean z-scores
features.specific: Overall (all mice): 14-parameter sociality phenotype heatmap, parameter table, Phenotype space (PCA) coloured by type, Type membership table, 'What defines each phenotype type' bars; k slider (2–5) in the sidebar
steps: Open Individual sociality → Overall
Read the z-scored heatmap and the parameter table
Set k with the Phenotype clusters slider
Check the PCA plot and Type membership
Read which parameters define each type
serves_tasks: Compute each individual's multi-parameter profile and cluster into types

features.name: Focus-individual dossier
features.general: Pick one individual and get a linked set of views: radar of its z-profile, raw values against the group median, its ego-network, significant partners, directed approach arrows, and association to each partner over time
features.specific: Individual detail: Focus mouse dropdown → '<id> — phenotype · type', radar, values-vs-median bars, ego-network (SRI to partners), Significant partners (preferred/avoided), who-approaches-whom arrows, SRI-to-each-partner-over-time heatmap
steps: Choose the Focus mouse
Read its type and radar profile
Check the ego-network and its preferred/avoided partners
Read the approach arrows and the partner-SRI-over-time heatmap
Repeat for another individual
serves_tasks: Inspect one individual in depth
Find hubs, brokers and isolates

features.name: Per-layer CSV export and server-side run archive
features.general: Download the current tables (matrices, metrics, time series, phenotype tables) as CSV, or archive the whole run to a timestamped folder on the server
features.specific: Export tabs: SRI matrix / Node metrics / Approach matrix CSV; Group metrics / Group-over-time / Node metrics CSV; Phenotype table / Phenotype z-scores CSV; 💾 Save phenotype run to outputs/
steps: Open the Export tab of the current layer
Press a ⬇ CSV button to download
Optionally press Save run to outputs/ and read the saved path
serves_tasks: Download network matrices and metrics as tables
Download group-over-time summaries
Download or archive the per-individual phenotype table

features.name: Contextual definitions (glossary + per-panel ❓ popovers)
features.general: Look up the meaning of each term and metric in place: one global glossary table plus a short definition attached to each chart or table
features.specific: ❓ Glossary & definitions popover (sri, co-location, sampling period, permutation, threshold, window, strength…) and a ❓ chevron on each panel (e.g. Node network metrics, Association network) that opens its definition
steps: Click ❓ Glossary & definitions to open the term table
Close it with Escape
Click the ❓ chevron on a panel to read that panel's definition
serves_tasks: Look up what each metric means
